grades.reason: Directly identifies a possible outcome: a misaligned-address exception, specifically for vector whole-register loads and stores.

grades.quote:
Loads and stores whose effective address is not naturally aligned to the referenced datatype (i.e., the effective address is not divisible by the size of the access in bytes) have behavior dependent on the EEI.

An EEI may guarantee that misaligned loads and stores are fully supported, and so the software running inside the execution environment will never experience a contained or fatal address-

misaligned trap. In this case, the misaligned loads and stores can be handled in hardware, or via an invisible trap into the execution environment implementation, or possibly a combination of hardware and invisible trap depending on address.
grades.reason: Directly explains environment-dependent behavior, including hardware handling and invisible traps without software-visible misalignment traps.
